tools.name: login
tools.description: Sign in with a UMD Directory ID. Opens a dedicated browser window (Chrome or Edge) at the UMD login page and waits up to 5 minutes for the user to finish, including Duo; the window closes by itself afterwards. The same sign-in also establishes sessions with every service other tools need (e.g. Testudo). Some services force re-authentication, so expect a prompt even if the user signed in recently. Call this when another tool reports that sign-in is required or a session has expired.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Forget the signed-in user and every service session, and clear the sign-in browser so the next login prompts again.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Report the currently signed-in UMD user, or that nobody is signed in, and which services have a live session.

tools.name: planetterp_get_course
tools.description: Look up a UMD course by its code on PlanetTerp. Returns catalog information, the average GPA, professors who have taught it, and student reviews written for it. No login needed.

tools.name: planetterp_list_courses
tools.description: List UMD courses on PlanetTerp in alphabetical order, optionally within one department. No login needed.

department.description: Only list courses in this four-letter department, e.g. "CMSC" (default: all departments)

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-100 (default 100)

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: planetterp_get_professor
tools.description: Look up a UMD professor or teaching assistant by name on PlanetTerp. Returns the courses they have taught, their average rating, and student reviews. No login needed.

name.description: Name of the professor, e.g. "Jon Snow"

tools.name: planetterp_list_professors
tools.description: List UMD professors and teaching assistants on PlanetTerp in alphabetical order. No login needed.

type.description: Only list professors ("professor") or teaching assistants ("ta"); default: both

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-100 (default 100)

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: planetterp_get_grades
tools.description: Grade distributions from PlanetTerp for a course, a professor, or both, broken down by section. At least one of course or professor is required; semester and section narrow the result. No login needed.

course.description: Only include grades for this course, e.g. "MATH140"

professor.description: Only include grades for sections taught by this professor, e.g. "Jon Snow"

semester.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

section.description: Only include this section, e.g. "101" or "0101" (default: all sections)

tools.name: planetterp_search
tools.description: Search PlanetTerp for courses and professors whose code or name contains the query, as the site search bar does. Use this to find the exact course code or professor name before calling planetterp_get_course or planetterp_get_professor. No login needed.

query.description: Text to search for, e.g. "CMSC13" or "Snow"

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-100 (default 30)

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: nutrition_get_menu
tools.description: What a UMD dining hall is serving on a given day, by meal period and station, with allergens and dietary labels for each dish, from nutrition.umd.edu. No login needed.

hall.description: Dining hall to get the menu for

date.description: Day to get the menu for, as YYYY-MM-DD (default: today). Menus are posted about a week ahead.

tools.name: nutrition_get_recipe
tools.description: The nutrition label for a dish on a UMD dining hall menu: serving size, calories, nutrition facts with daily values, ingredients and allergens. Use the id from nutrition_get_menu. No login needed.

id.description: Recipe identifier from a menu item, e.g. "060064*2"

tools.name: testudo_soc_list_terms
tools.description: Terms the UMD Schedule of Classes currently lists (about four: the current term plus the next few). Returns the term ids the other Schedule of Classes tools take. No login needed.

tools.name: testudo_soc_list_departments
tools.description: Departments (four-letter course prefixes) offering courses in a term, from the UMD Schedule of Classes. No login needed.

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

tools.name: testudo_soc_list_courses
tools.description: Every course a department offers in a term, from the UMD Schedule of Classes: title, credits, grading methods, gen-ed codes, prerequisites and description. Sections are not included; call testudo_soc_get_sections or testudo_soc_get_course for those. No login needed.

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

tools.name: testudo_soc_get_course
tools.description: One course in a term from the UMD Schedule of Classes, with every section: instructors, seat counts, meeting days, times, rooms and delivery method. No login needed.

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

tools.name: testudo_soc_get_sections
tools.description: Sections of one or more courses in a term, from the UMD Schedule of Classes: instructors, seat counts, meeting days, times, rooms and delivery method. Seat counts are a snapshot refreshed roughly hourly, not real time. No login needed.

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

course_ids.description: Course ids to get sections for, up to 10 per call, e.g. ["CMSC131", "CMSC132"]

teaching_center.description: Only sections taught at this location or in this program: "ALL" all locations and programs, "*" College Park campus, "DC" District of Columbia, "FS" Frostburg State, "HG" Hagerstown, "HT" Heat Center, Harford County, "RB" Reagan Building, "SG" Shady Grove, "SM" Southern Maryland, "BA" University of Maryland, Baltimore, "FC" Freshmen Connection, "PP" Professional Programs, face to face, "OF" Professional Programs, online, "LS" Science in the Evening, "SE" Universities at Shady Grove / EDUC (default "ALL")

tools.name: testudo_soc_search_courses
tools.description: Search the UMD Schedule of Classes for a term the way its search form does. Needs at least one of course_id (a department prefix, partial id or full id), instructor, or delivery; the other fields narrow the results. When the search narrows by section (instructor, days, time, delivery, open seats, credits or level) the matching sections come back inline; otherwise sections are null and testudo_soc_get_sections fetches them. No login needed.

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

course_id.description: Department prefix ("CMSC"), partial id ("CMSC13") or full course id ("CMSC131") to match

section_id.description: Only this section, e.g. "0101"; use together with a full course_id

instructor.description: Instructor name as testudo_soc_autocomplete_instructors returns it in `name`, e.g. "Gonzalez, Elias"

open_sections_only.description: Only sections with open seats (default false)

credits.description: Only courses whose credits satisfy credits_compare against this value, 0-4

credits_compare.description: How to compare course credits with `credits` (default "=")

delivery.description: Only sections taught in these ways (default: any)

time_compare.description: Only sections whose meetings start "after", "at" or "before" start_time, or "between" start_time and end_time

start_time.description: Time for time_compare, on the quarter hour, e.g. "12:00 PM" or "9:30 AM"

end_time.description: End of the range when time_compare is "between", e.g. "3:00 PM"

days.description: Only sections that meet on these weekdays

teaching_center.description: Only sections taught at this location or in this program: "ALL" all locations and programs, "*" College Park campus, "DC" District of Columbia, "FS" Frostburg State, "HG" Hagerstown, "HT" Heat Center, Harford County, "RB" Reagan Building, "SG" Shady Grove, "SM" Southern Maryland, "BA" University of Maryland, Baltimore, "FC" Freshmen Connection, "PP" Professional Programs, face to face, "OF" Professional Programs, online, "LS" Science in the Evening, "SE" Universities at Shady Grove / EDUC (default "ALL")

tools.name: testudo_soc_autocomplete_courses
tools.description: Course ids and titles in a term whose id starts with the given text, from the UMD Schedule of Classes autocomplete. The cheapest way to find what a department offers or to resolve a partial course id. No login needed.

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

query.description: Start of a course id, e.g. "CMSC" (all CMSC courses) or "CMSC13"

tools.name: testudo_soc_autocomplete_instructors
tools.description: Instructors teaching in a term whose last or first name contains the given text, from the UMD Schedule of Classes autocomplete. Pass the returned `name` as the instructor to testudo_soc_search_courses. No login needed.

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

query.description: Part of a last or first name, at least two characters, e.g. "gonz"

tools.name: testudo_soc_list_gen_ed_categories
tools.description: The general education categories and requirement codes (FSAW, DSHS, DVUP, ...) the UMD Schedule of Classes lists for a term. No login needed.

term_id.description: Term to list for (default: the newest term)

tools.name: testudo_soc_list_gen_ed_courses
tools.description: Courses fulfilling one general education requirement in a term, from the UMD Schedule of Classes. Sections are not included; call testudo_soc_get_sections for those. No login needed.

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

code.description: General education code from testudo_soc_list_gen_ed_categories, e.g. "DSNL"

tools.name: testudo_soc_list_syllabi
tools.description: Past syllabi on file for a course in the UMD Schedule of Classes syllabus repository: the term and instructor of each. The PDFs themselves need a UMD login. No login needed for the list.

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

tools.name: testudo_soc_get_building
tools.description: Look up a classroom building by the building code and room number a section lists (e.g. "IRB" "0324"): full name, campus building number and map links. No login needed.

building.description: Building code as shown on a section, e.g. "IRB"

room.description: Room number as shown on the section, e.g. "0324"; the lookup needs one

tools.name: testudo_get_current_term
tools.description: The current academic term at UMD with its registration status and key dates, from the Testudo student portal. Requires login.

tools.name: testudo_list_terms
tools.description: Terms the signed-in student can use with a given Testudo feature: "schedule" lists terms with a class schedule (use with testudo_get_schedule), "grades" terms with posted grades, "enrollment_certification" terms an enrollment certification can be ordered for, "graduation" every term a graduation date can fall in, "graduation_application" terms open for a graduation application, and "grade_option" terms with an open pass/fail election window. Requires login.

kind.description: Which feature's term list to return

tools.name: testudo_get_schedule
tools.description: The signed-in student's class schedule for a term from the Testudo student portal: each registered section with its instructors, credits, delivery method and weekly meetings (days, times, building and room). Use testudo_list_terms with kind "schedule" for the terms available. Requires login.

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

tools.name: testudo_get_grades
tools.description: The signed-in student's grades for a term from the Testudo student portal: final grades once posted, mid-term grades while the term runs, and the semester and cumulative GPA. Use testudo_list_terms with kind "grades" for the terms available. Requires login.

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

tools.name: testudo_get_unofficial_transcript
tools.description: The signed-in student's unofficial transcript from the Testudo student portal, as plain text: transfer credit, every past course with its grade, and current courses. For advising purposes only. Requires login.

tools.name: testudo_get_profile
tools.description: The signed-in student's contact information on file with the university, from the Testudo student portal: name, email, phone numbers, local and permanent addresses and emergency contact. Requires login.

tools.name: testudo_get_registration_appointment
tools.description: When the signed-in student may register for classes, from the Testudo student portal: the registration appointment for the upcoming term, any blocks on the account, and the majors, minors and certificates on record. Read-only; this does not register for anything. Requires login.

tools.name: testudo_get_request_status
tools.description: Status of the official transcript and enrollment certification orders the signed-in student has placed through the Testudo student portal, and any judicial or financial block that would stop new orders. Read-only; ordering is not supported. Requires login.

tools.name: testudo_get_graduation_application_status
tools.description: The signed-in student's graduation applications from the Testudo student portal: the term applied for, the diploma name and mailing address, and the status of each degree. Read-only; applying is not supported. Requires login.

tools.name: testudo_get_grade_options
tools.description: The grading option (regular or pass/fail) the signed-in student has elected for each course in a term, from the Testudo student portal, with the pass/fail credit totals. Only populated while the term's election window is open; use testudo_list_terms with kind "grade_option" to find such terms. Read-only; changing an option is not supported. Requires login.

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

tools.name: testudo_get_parent_access
tools.description: Parent or guest accounts the signed-in student has granted access to their Testudo records. Read-only; granting or revoking access is not supported. Requires login.

tools.name: athletics_list_sports
tools.description: Every varsity sport at Maryland (the Terps, umterps.com) with the ids the other athletics tools take. No login needed.

tools.name: athletics_list_seasons
tools.description: Past and current seasons a sport has a schedule for, with the schedule id to pass to athletics_get_schedule for a past season. No login needed.

sport_id.description: Sport id from athletics_list_sports, e.g. 3 for Football

tools.name: athletics_get_schedule
tools.description: A Maryland team's schedule and results: every game with date, time, opponent, venue, TV/streaming, and the score once played, plus the team's record. Defaults to the current season; pass a schedule id from athletics_list_seasons for a past one. No login needed.

sport_id.description: Sport id from athletics_list_sports, e.g. 3 for Football

season_schedule_id.description: Schedule id of a past season from athletics_list_seasons (default: current season)

tools.name: athletics_get_game
tools.description: One Maryland game by id (from athletics_get_schedule or athletics_get_calendar): opponent, venue, media links and result. No login needed.

tools.name: athletics_get_roster
tools.description: A Maryland team's current roster: players with jersey number, position, class, height, weight, hometown and major, plus the coaching staff. No login needed.

sport_id.description: Sport id from athletics_list_sports, e.g. 3 for Football

tools.name: athletics_search_players
tools.description: Find current and former Maryland athletes by last name, across all seasons on umterps.com, optionally within one sport. No login needed.

last_name.description: Start of the last name, e.g. "Lock" or just "L"

sport_id.description: Sport id from athletics_list_sports, e.g. 3 for Football

tools.name: athletics_get_coaches
tools.description: A Maryland team's coaching staff with titles, email, phone and bio page links. No login needed.

sport_id.description: Sport id from athletics_list_sports, e.g. 3 for Football

tools.name: athletics_get_news
tools.description: Latest Maryland Athletics news stories, newest first, optionally for one sport. Pass a story id to athletics_get_article for the full text. No login needed.

sport_id.description: Sport id from athletics_list_sports, e.g. 3 for Football

page_size.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-50 (default 10)

tools.name: athletics_get_article
tools.description: The full text of a Maryland Athletics news story (game recaps, previews, announcements) by story id. No login needed.

story_id.description: Story id from athletics_get_news or a game

tools.name: athletics_get_calendar
tools.description: Every Maryland game or event in a date range across all sports (or one sport), grouped by day, with opponents, venues, media links and results. No login needed.

sport_id.description: Sport id from athletics_list_sports, e.g. 3 for Football

tools.name: athletics_get_upcoming_events
tools.description: A Maryland team's next few games with date, time, opponent, venue and where to watch. No login needed.

sport_id.description: Sport id from athletics_list_sports, e.g. 3 for Football

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-20 (default 5)

tools.name: athletics_get_live_scores
tools.description: Maryland games in progress right now with their live scores, as the site reports them; empty when nothing is being played. No login needed.

tools.name: calendar_search_events
tools.description: Events on the UMD campus calendar (calendar.umd.edu) in a date range, optionally narrowed by full-text query, event type, audience or featured status. Recurring events are expanded into occurrences. Returns the total so the caller can page with offset. No login needed.

query.description: Full-text search over title and body, plain words, e.g. "gis"

start.description: Only events on or after this date (default: today)

end.description: Only events on or before this date (default: no limit)

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-100 (default 10)

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: calendar_get_event
tools.description: One event from the UMD campus calendar by id or slug, with its full description, location, contact and recurrence rule. No login needed.

slug.description: URL slug, e.g. "terps-after-dark-3"; used when id is not given

tools.name: calendar_list_categories
tools.description: The event-type, audience and status categories the UMD campus calendar files events under, with the slugs calendar_search_events accepts. No login needed.

tools.name: calendar_get_academic_calendar
tools.description: The approved UMD semester calendars from the Office of the Provost: first and last day of classes, breaks, reading day, final exams, commencement and summer sessions for each academic year, several years ahead. Dates are as printed (no year; the season and academic year give it). No login needed.

year.description: Only academic years whose name contains this text, e.g. "2027" or "Fall 2026 - Summer 2027" (default: all)

tools.name: dining_get_busy_meter
tools.description: Current crowd level (less, moderately or extremely busy) of the three UMD dining halls, from the service behind the "Dining Hall Status" page. The service has been returning errors; when it does, `available` is false and the UMD mobile app is the alternative. No login needed.

tools.name: dining_get_calendar
tools.description: Key dates for the current semester from UMD Dining Services: when dining plans go live, holiday and break hours, closures and Dining Dollar expiry. No login needed.

tools.name: dining_get_news
tools.description: The newest posts on dining.umd.edu, mainly "The Dish" monthly newsletter, from its RSS feed. No login needed.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-10 (default 10)

tools.name: directory_search
tools.description: Search the UMD campus directory for people by last name (prefix; "Pin*" wildcards work), full name, email address, Directory ID or phone number. No login needed for faculty, staff and affiliates (at most 50 results); after login students are included and up to 100 are returned.

query.description: Last name, full name, email, Directory ID or phone number, e.g. "Pines"

sounds_like.description: Also match last names that sound like the query, e.g. "Pynes" for Pines

tools.name: directory_search_advanced
tools.description: Search the UMD campus directory by separate name parts, email, work phone, department, affiliation and institution. At least one of the name, email or phone fields is required; department only narrows another field. No login needed for faculty, staff and affiliates; students are only included after login.

phone.description: Work phone, digits or dashed, e.g. "301-405-5803"

department.description: Department name to narrow by, e.g. "Computer Science"

affiliations.description: Affiliations to include (default: faculty, staff and affiliate, plus student when signed in)

items.description: Institution code: "UMCP" University of Maryland, College Park, "USMO" University System of Maryland Office, "UMES" University of Maryland Eastern Shore, "UMCES" University of Maryland Center for Environmental Science

tools.name: directory_get_person
tools.description: Look up one person in the UMD campus directory by Directory ID (the part of their email before @umd.edu). No login needed for faculty, staff and affiliates; students are only found after login.

directory_id.description: UMD Directory ID (the part of the email before @umd.edu), e.g. "djpines"

tools.name: elms_whoami
tools.description: The signed-in user as ELMS (Canvas) knows them: name, login id, email and time zone. Requires login.

tools.name: elms_list_courses
tools.description: The signed-in student's courses on ELMS (Canvas) with term, instructors and current grade standing. Course ids are what the other ELMS tools take. Requires login.

state.description: "active" for current courses, "completed" for past terms, "all" for both

tools.name: elms_get_course
tools.description: One ELMS (Canvas) course with its syllabus, front page and the navigation tabs enabled for it, so you know which of assignments, modules, announcements, files or external tools (Zoom, Piazza, Gradescope) exist. Requires login.

tools.name: elms_list_assignments
tools.description: Assignments in an ELMS (Canvas) course, ordered by due date, each with the signed-in student's submission status and score. Narrow with a bucket such as "upcoming" or "unsubmitted". Requires login.

bucket.description: Only assignments in this bucket (default: all)

tools.name: elms_get_submission
tools.description: The signed-in student's submission for one ELMS (Canvas) assignment: status, score, grade and any instructor comments. Requires login.

tools.name: elms_get_grades
tools.description: The signed-in student's current and final scores in every ELMS (Canvas) course they are enrolled in, or in one course. Requires login.

tools.name: elms_list_modules
tools.description: The modules of an ELMS (Canvas) course with their items (assignments, files, pages, links) and completion state. File items carry the link to lecture slides even when the Files tab is hidden. Requires login.

tools.name: elms_list_announcements
tools.description: Announcements posted in one or more ELMS (Canvas) courses within a date window (default: the last 14 days). Requires login.

course_ids.description: Courses to read announcements from, up to 20

tools.name: elms_get_todo
tools.description: Assignments the signed-in student still needs to submit, as ELMS (Canvas) lists them in the to-do sidebar. Requires login.

tools.name: elms_get_planner
tools.description: Everything due or happening for the signed-in student across all ELMS (Canvas) courses in a date range (default: the next 14 days): assignments, quizzes, announcements, events and notes, with submission status. The best single "what's due" feed. Requires login.

end_date.description: Last day to include (default: 14 days from today)

tools.name: elms_get_upcoming_events
tools.description: Upcoming calendar events and assignment due dates across all ELMS (Canvas) courses, as the Canvas dashboard shows them. Requires login.

tools.name: elms_get_activity_stream
tools.description: Recent activity across the signed-in student's active ELMS (Canvas) courses: new announcements, discussion posts, grades and messages. Requires login.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-50 (default 20)

tools.name: elms_list_conversations
tools.description: The signed-in student's ELMS (Canvas) Inbox: conversations with their subject, participants and last message. Requires login.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-100 (default 20)

tools.name: elms_get_conversation
tools.description: One ELMS (Canvas) Inbox conversation with every message in it. Requires login.

tools.name: recwell_get_facility_alerts
tools.description: Current RecWell facility alerts: holiday and reduced hours, closures and protocol changes, as headed sections with any hours tables. No login needed.

tools.name: recwell_list_facilities
tools.description: RecWell facilities with a one-paragraph description and link each, grouped as indoor or outdoor. Use recwell_get_facility for hours tables and details. No login needed.

tools.name: recwell_get_facility
tools.description: A RecWell facility's page: description, regular hours of operation per season (one tab per semester, as tables), access rules, rental and parking information. For today's actual hours use get_facility_hours. No login needed.

tools.name: recwell_get_group_fitness_schedule
tools.description: The weekly RecWell group fitness class schedule: class, location, instructor, start and end time and registration link, optionally for one weekday. Registration opens 24 hours before a class and needs the free Group Fitness membership. No login needed.

day.description: Only classes on this weekday (default: the whole week)

tools.name: recwell_list_club_sports
tools.description: Every RecWell club sport with its website, contact email and donation page. Joining means emailing the club and registering on IMLeagues. No login needed.

tools.name: senate_list_legislation
tools.description: Bills before the University Senate (senate.umd.edu): the current academic year's legislation with where each bill stands and who is reviewing it, or the archive of past bills back to 2001. Filter by words in the title or document number. Call senate_get_bill for a bill's history and documents. No login needed.

scope.description: "current" for this year's bills (default), "archived" for past years

query.description: Only bills whose title or document number contains this text

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-200 (default 50)

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: senate_get_bill
tools.description: One University Senate bill by id or document number: the proposal, sponsor, policy link, related bills, and every stage of its history (committee reviews, Senate votes, presidential approval) with dates, decisions and the PDFs filed at each stage. No login needed.

bill.description: Bill id (e.g. "987") or Senate document number (e.g. "26-27-04"), from senate_list_legislation or senate_get_committee

tools.name: senate_list_senators
tools.description: Current members of the University Senate with the seat, constituency, college and term end of each. Filter by college or division acronym, population, constituency, or a name search. No login needed.

college.description: Only senators for this college or division acronym, e.g. "CMNS", "ENGR", "VPSA"

population.description: Only senators for this population, e.g. "Faculty" or "Undergraduate Student"

constituency.description: Only senators for this constituency, e.g. "Tenured/Tenure-Track Faculty", "Exempt Staff - Divisions"

query.description: Only senators whose name, email or seat contains this text

tools.name: senate_get_constituent
tools.description: How the University Senate files a member of the campus community, by UMD Directory ID: their college, department, title, population and constituency. To find who represents them, call senate_list_senators with that constituency, and with the college too when represented_by_college is true, as the site's "Find My Senator" tool does. No login needed.

directory_id.description: UMD Directory ID, the part of a umd.edu email before the @

tools.name: senate_list_committees
tools.description: The University Senate's standing and special committees, the University councils it seats, and past councils and task forces, each with a one-paragraph summary. Pass a name to senate_get_committee for its charge, members and current work. No login needed.

type.description: Only "committee" (Senate committees), "council" (University councils) or "past_council" (dissolved councils and task forces); default: all

tools.name: senate_get_committee
tools.description: One University Senate committee, University council, or past council or task force by name (from senate_list_committees): its page as text (charge, chair, contact), current members with seats and colleges, and the bills it is reviewing. See senate_list_past_committee_legislation for earlier bills and senate_get_committee_meetings for meeting dates. No login needed.

name.description: Name as senate_list_committees gives it, e.g. "Academic Procedures & Standards"

tools.name: senate_list_past_committee_legislation
tools.description: Every bill each University Senate standing committee has reviewed, grouped by committee and academic year back to 2001, as the Past Committees page lists them: document number, title, whether the bill is still active and when it completed. Optionally one committee. No login needed.

committee.description: Only this committee, named as senate_list_committees gives it, e.g. "Academic Procedures & Standards" (default: every committee)

tools.name: senate_get_committee_meetings
tools.description: A University Senate standing committee's meeting dates and times for an academic year (default: the current one), with the agendas posted for each; other meeting materials need a committee member login. No login needed.

committee.description: Committee name as senate_list_committees gives it, e.g. "Academic Procedures & Standards"

tools.name: senate_get_meetings
tools.description: The University Senate meeting schedule for an academic year (default: the current one) with the agenda, materials, slides and minutes posted for each meeting, and the years the archive covers. Meetings run 3:15-5:00 PM unless a document says otherwise. No login needed.

tools.name: terplink_search_organizations
tools.description: Search the roughly 1,000 active student organizations on TerpLink by name or keyword, optionally within categories from terplink_list_organization_categories. Returns summaries; call terplink_get_organization for contact details. No login needed.

query.description: Words to match in the name or description

category_ids.description: Only organizations with any of these ids

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-50 (default 20)

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: terplink_get_organization
tools.description: Full profile of one TerpLink student organization: description, email, type, primary contact, social links and mailing address. No login needed.

organization.description: Website key (e.g. "kedma", from terplink_search_organizations or the public URL) or numeric organization id

tools.name: terplink_list_organization_categories
tools.description: The categories TerpLink files student organizations under (Academic, Cultural/Ethnic, Honor Society, ...). Use the ids with terplink_search_organizations. No login needed.

tools.name: terplink_search_events
tools.description: Search TerpLink events by keyword, date range, hosting organization, category, theme or perk. Upcoming and ongoing events only unless include_past is set. Times are ISO 8601. No login needed.

query.description: Words to match in the name or description

starts_after.description: Only events starting on or after this date

ends_before.description: Only events ending before this date

include_past.description: Also return events that have already ended (default false)

organization_ids.description: Only events hosted by organizations with any of these ids

category_ids.description: Only events in categories (see terplink_list_event_categories) with any of these ids

themes.description: Only events with any of these themes

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-50 (default 20)

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: terplink_get_event
tools.description: Full details of one TerpLink event: description, venue or meeting link, hosts, categories, perks and RSVP capacity. No login needed.

tools.name: terplink_list_event_categories
tools.description: The categories TerpLink events are tagged with (Academic, Service, Sports and Recreation, ...). Use the ids with terplink_search_events. No login needed.

tools.name: terplink_get_news
tools.description: News articles student organizations and departments post on TerpLink, newest first, optionally filtered by keyword or organization. Call terplink_get_article for the body. No login needed.

query.description: Words to match in the title or body

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-50 (default 20)

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: terplink_get_article
tools.description: One TerpLink news article with its full body as plain text. No login needed.

tools.name: terplink_search_service_opportunities
tools.description: Volunteer and community service opportunities listed for UMD students (mirrored from GivePulse), searchable by keyword. Includes past listings. No login needed.

query.description: Words to match in the title or description

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1-50 (default 20)

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: transportation_list_routes
tools.description: Every Shuttle-UM bus route in the current timetable (regular routes such as 104 College Park Metro plus event routes), with whether each runs today, from the published GTFS feed. No login needed.

tools.name: transportation_get_route
tools.description: One Shuttle-UM route with its stops in order (for the most common trip pattern on the given day) and the route polyline, from the published GTFS feed. No login needed.

route.description: Route id as in transportation_list_routes, e.g. "104" (event routes have longer ids)

date.description: Service date as YYYY-MM-DD (default: today in College Park)

tools.name: transportation_list_stops
tools.description: Shuttle-UM bus stops from the published GTFS feed, filtered by a name fragment or by distance from a point. Without a filter, every stop. No login needed.

query.description: Only stops whose name contains this text, e.g. "Stamp"

radius_m.description: Search radius in metres around lat/lon (default 500)

tools.name: transportation_get_stop
tools.description: One Shuttle-UM bus stop with its location and every route that serves it, from the published GTFS feed. No login needed.

tools.name: transportation_get_schedule
tools.description: Scheduled departures of a Shuttle-UM route on a date, optionally at one stop, from the published GTFS feed. Times are scheduled, not live; real-time arrivals are only in the Transit app. Without a stop only timepoint stops are listed, to keep the answer short. No login needed.

route.description: Route id as in transportation_list_routes, e.g. "104" (event routes have longer ids)

date.description: Service date as YYYY-MM-DD (default: today in College Park)

stop.description: Only departures from this stop, e.g. "1001"

after.description: Only departures at or after this local time, as HH:MM

tools.name: transportation_get_service_alerts
tools.description: Current Shuttle-UM system updates and alerts (detours, schedule changes) and the modified-service notices linked from the DOTS schedules page. Delays are not posted here, only in the Transit app. No login needed.

tools.name: transportation_get_service_calendar
tools.description: The Shuttle-UM service calendar for the academic year: for each break, exam week and intersemester period, the dates and whether service is regular or modified, with the notice page for the detail. No login needed.
